title: Second-epoch ALMA Observations of 321 GHz Water Maser Emission in NGC 4945 and the Circinus Galaxy
question: Investigate the flux variability, nuclear kinematics, and spatial structure of 321 GHz H2O maser and continuum emission in NGC 4945 and the Circinus galaxy using second-epoch higher-resolution ALMA observations.

data.arrays: 12-m array (45 antennas for NGC 4945, 47 antennas for Circinus)
data.angular_resolution: ~0.3 arcsec (0.381x0.313 arcsec for NGC 4945; 0.330x0.206 arcsec for Circinus)
data.sensitivity: Continuum rms: 0.6 mJy beam^-1 (both); Line rms (per 0.458 km s^-1 channel): 12.6 mJy beam^-1 (NGC 4945), 13.9 mJy beam^-1 (Circinus)

what.value: First-epoch (2012-06-03) ALMA 321 GHz H2O maser and continuum measurements and spectra for Circinus galaxy and NGC 4945

evidence.quote: Hagiwara et al. (2013) conducted a search for H 2 O masers in the 10 29 −9 36 transition (ν rest = 321.226GHz) toward H 2 O megamaser galaxies
The detection of 321 GHz H 2 O maser emission toward the center of NGC 4945 from this search was reported later (Hagiwara et al. 2016; Pesce et al. 2016).

external_data.citation: Hagiwara et al. (2013), Hagiwara et al. (2016), Pesce et al. (2016)

what.value: Earlier Tidbinbilla 22 GHz H2O maser spectra from 2012 and 2014

evidence.quote: Note—(2) Date of observations in YYYY-mm-dd format (a: From published data in Hagiwara et al. (2016), b: from Hagiwara et al. (2013))

external_data.citation: Hagiwara et al. (2013), Hagiwara et al. (2016)

what.value: VLBI 22 GHz H2O maser disk parameters (radius 0.1-0.4 pc, enclosed mass 1.7x10^6 M_sun, PA 29 deg and 56 deg) in Circinus galaxy

evidence.quote: approximately two orders of magnitude larger than the enclosed mass of ∼1.7×10 [6] M ⊙ within r = 0.1 pc that was measured by VLBI observations, assuming a circular motion (Greenhill et al. 2003b).
largely agrees with that of the 22 GHz H 2 O maser disk (29 [◦] ±3 [◦] at r = 0.1 pc, and 56 [◦] ±6 [◦] at r = 0.4 pc (Greenhill et al. 2003b).

what.value: ALMA CO(3-2) circumnuclear disk molecular gas mass (M_H2 ~ 3x10^6 M_sun within central ~75 pc) and size in Circinus galaxy

evidence.quote: the circumnuclear disk probed by CO (3–2) molecular gas with the deconvolved source size of 3.62 [′′] × 1.66 [′′]

recipe.goal: Extract 321 GHz H2O maser spectra and measure continuum and line flux properties
recipe.method: Integrate over the full line-free frequency range to produce 321 GHz continuum maps, extract maser spectra toward the galaxy centers, and measure peak and integrated fluxes and positions
key_parameters: Velocity search range V_LSR = -319.5 to 1436.5 km s^-1 (NGC 4945) and -439.9 to 1314.1 km s^-1 (Circinus)
SNR > 5 between V_LSR = 200 and 800 km s^-1 for integrated intensity in Circinus

recipe.goal: Reduce Tidbinbilla 22 GHz H2O maser monitoring spectra and compare with ALMA 321 GHz spectra
recipe.method: Perform baseline calibration, polarization averaging, and scan flagging on Tidbinbilla 70-m data to produce multi-epoch 22 GHz spectra for variability and velocity comparison with 321 GHz spectra
key_parameters: Spectral resolution 31.25 kHz or 0.42 km s^-1
assumptions: Telescope sensitivity of 2.6 Jy K^-1 with 50% flux density uncertainty

recipe.goal: Compute moment maps and deconvolved source size of 321 GHz maser emission in Circinus
recipe.method: Generate 0th, 1st, and 2nd moment maps from the spectral-line cube of the Circinus galaxy and deconvolve the 0th moment emission by the synthesized beam
key_parameters: Velocity range V_LSR = 228-685 km s^-1 (or 256-670 km s^-1 for 1st/2nd moment maps)

recipe.goal: Calculate isotropic luminosity, disk radius, and dynamical mass for Circinus galaxy
recipe.method: Compute isotropic luminosity from integrated intensity, and derive rotating disk radius and enclosed dynamical mass from the measured velocity gradient and maximum rotation velocity
key_parameters: dV/dl = 8.8 km s^-1 pc^-1 along PA = 35 deg, V_rot = 682 - 433 ~ 250 km s^-1
assumptions: Isotropic radiation of the maser and distance D = 4.2 Mpc
Simple circular rotation disk with inclination i > 75 deg (sin i ~ 1) and sin(theta) ~ theta

not_stated_but_needed: CASA and AIPS versions used for calibration, imaging, and analysis
Exact frequency/velocity ranges of the line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Image pixel/cell size, image dimensions, and CLEAN stopping threshold or masking strategy
Exact division of tasks between CASA and AIPS during imaging and moment map generation
Flux threshold or clipping level used when computing the 0th, 1st, and 2nd moment maps
missing_for_reproduction: Exact line-free channel ranges used for uv-plane continuum subtraction
CLEAN imaging parameters (pixel size, image dimensions, stopping threshold, masking) and specific tasks run in CASA versus AIPS
Clipping threshold and exact channel selection used to construct the 0th, 1st, and 2nd moment maps
Raw or reduced Tidbinbilla DSS-43 single-dish spectra (not archived in ALMA)
score_reason: Both ALMA project codes are clearly identified and use standard calibration and Briggs robust=0.5 imaging with channel smoothing specified, making spectral and continuum flux extraction straightforward to reproduce, though moment-map clipping thresholds and exact CASA/AIPS parameters are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA datasets (#2016.1.00150.S and #2011.0.00121.S) with clear quantitative targets (continuum fluxes, maser peak/integrated fluxes, deconvolved size, velocity gradient, and dynamical mass).
